recovery.title: If you already sent money
recovery.subtitle: Stay calm. Act step by step.
steps: Call your bank or UPI app fraud helpline right now and report the transaction.
Do not send any more money, even if they say it will 'unlock' or 'refund' your funds.
Save screenshots of chats, UPI IDs, phone numbers, and bank SMS.
File a complaint on the National Cyber Crime Portal: cybercrime.gov.in
Dial 1930 (India cyber fraud helpline) if money was transferred recently.
Tell a trusted family member what happened — you do not have to handle this alone.
